title: Let service make room for the Lord
summary: The line refuses to let self-importance dress itself as honesty, intelligence, or force. Do not let the day outrun this: carry this with you: let the Guru's truth reach your food, speech, and shelter.
takeaway: Treat ego as illness, not identity.
lifeApplication: At the next success, apology, or argument, listen, yield, or ask forgiveness before the self swells.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes clean when it lets the Lord dwell within and keeps filth from sticking.
source.lifeApplication: Before the next useful act, ask whether it makes room for the Lord or for your image.
